attempted_claim: For SU(2) stochastic Yang-Mills on T^3 in DeTurck gauge with CCHS regularity-structure renormalization, there exists an explicit coupling threshold g0 > 0 such that for all g in (0, g0], renormalized solutions from CCHS gauge-orbit data extend globally (blow-up time tau = infinity a.s.) and the induced Markov process on gauge orbits admits a unique invariant measure mu with exponential ergodicity ||P_t F - mu(F)|| <= C e^{-gamma t} ||F||_Lip for an explicit gamma > 0.
claim_type: singular-SPDE global well-posedness threshold with invariant-measure ergodicity gap
decisive_failure: Complete target_claim (global no-blow-up plus exponential ergodicity for ALL CCHS gauge-orbit data at fixed g0>0 with explicit gamma) NOT proved: the reduction to two uniform continuum inequalities (U1 Palais-Smale gap D>=c0 E above floor; U2 rough-drift bound |T|<=P1 E^{3/4}+P2 E^{1/2} with uniform-in-epsilon K_ren) is explicit but (U1)+(U2) remain OPEN with rough Psi coefficients in C^{-1/4} regularity. Lattice proxies (12-ray uniform crossing, adversarial min D/E~10.7, T/D~8e-4 flat, concentration D/E^3~0.27 const) are mechanism evidence only, not continuum proofs; paracontrolled remainder estimate in C([0,1];C^{-1/4}) uniform in epsilon NOT closed. Exact fallback success criterion NOT met: no sup-epsilon remainder bound certificate with numbered ledger estimates, and no single epsilon->0-divergent obstruction term isolated (proven obstructions are fixed-epsilon slice-norm/data-uniformity facts, not epsilon divergences). Strongest emergent candidate (exact slice-L^2 impossibility) rests on textbook Yang-Mills algebra (flat abelian constants, Lagrange/skew identities, OU exit arithmetic) without independent prior-art exclusion, so claiming it as a novel finding would overclaim originality. Gap re-verification used only public arXiv abstract pages (CCHS 2201.03487 v2; Chevyrev-Shen 2503.03060 v2); no full-text theorem audit beyond admitted triage. All rerunnable scripts use stdlib+numpy only with fixed seeds; lattice results carry stated resolution caveats (notably 48^3/24^3/16^3 under-resolution of quartic tails).
